properties.active:
SELECT employee_id, TRIM(full_name) AS full_name_masked, department_id, department_name,
       CASE WHEN TRIM(email) = '' THEN NULL ELSE TRIM(email) END AS email_masked,
       shift_id, status, updated_at
FROM FLOWFILE
WHERE status = 'active'

properties.SQL Query:
SELECT e.employee_id, e.full_name, e.email, e.department_id, d.department_name,
       e.shift_id, e.status, e.updated_at
FROM hr_db.employees e
JOIN hr_db.departments d ON d.department_id = e.department_id
ORDER BY e.employee_id
